newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel's representative rate was fixed lower against the dollar on Thursday following the rise of the U.S. currency in Asia, dealers said.
"The shekel declined against the dollar after the dollar rose in Asia against the yen. The basket remained stable during the day closing almost unchanged," said a dealer at United Mizrahi Bank.
"Volume was moderate and activity was mixed and balanced with slightly more conversions of shekels into dollars," she said.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.3960 shekels against 3.3880 on Wednesday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.7041 shekels against 3.7042 on Wednesday.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9358 shekels per 100 yen compared with 2.9765 on Wednesday, and against the mark at 2.0063 shekels compared with 2.0080 on Wednesday.
In the late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.3955 shekels.
